name: Design Extractor
description: Extracts the real graphic assets (photos, illustrations, logos, avatars, backgrounds, textures, screenshots, design-specific icons) from one or more static JPG or PNG mockups, with or without an asset size spec (Markdown, Excel or CSV). With a spec, it matches each image to its row and exports it at the requested ratio, size and weight, with a coverage report across all mockups. Exact crops and downscaling only: no generative AI, no retouching.
